name: tumble-rush
description: Tumble Rush — a single-player 3D bean battle-royale party game for the browser.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-invariants.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && vite build
scripts.check:release: npm run check && playwright test e2e/review1.spec.ts e2e/review2.spec.ts
scripts.gate:release: npm run check && npm run verify:show && npm run verify:pacing -- --phase=b && npm run verify:variety && npm run test:e2e
